summary: Across 2014 and 2023 Instagram posts, Olivia Chow articulates broad support for strengthening Toronto's social services. Chow advocates for expanded childcare, school nutrition programs, after-school care, and youth employment supports, and identifies child poverty as a priority concern (tTEEA0OtEL, tlEZvnutGS, ugKSbCutDk). Chow supports public libraries operating seven days a week, expanded shelter and respite services for unhoused people, increased core funding for non-profits, and the city-wide expansion of the Toronto Community Crisis Service (Cszj-OQtdG9, CsHejOWP0rO, Cs7XZJHAug5, CuX95hrA4Qv). Chow states support for 2SLGBTQI+ communities, opposition to Islamophobia and antisemitism, and backing for culturally sensitive health services and Indigenous-focused responses to gender-based violence (Cs9ZwzVPU-L, Cuh98p0PPkX, CtSF49tP4K6, CswRXNBAo-m, Cr33PZjPo8E). Chow also pledges support for seniors, workers, and people with disabilities (uJqN2uOtLA, CrtSNhOgByS, tQqAqWOtEK).

key_positions.stance: Supports expanded childcare, including creation of new childcare spaces and $15/day childcare
Supports expanding school nutrition and food programs
Supports addressing youth unemployment and creating jobs and after-school programs for young people
Supports expanding public library service so all branches operate seven days a week
Supports expanded supports for unhoused people, including 24/7 respite spaces, wrap-around services, and shelter funding; opposes the City's prior approach of moving unhoused people between locations
Supports city-wide expansion of the Toronto Community Crisis Service for non-police mental-health response
Supports increased and improved core funding for non-profit social-service organizations
Supports the 2SLGBTQI+ community and opposes rising homophobia and transphobia
Opposes Islamophobia and antisemitism and supports public education and anti-hate campaigns
Supports addressing gender-based and intimate partner violence, including in the context of reconciliation with Indigenous communities
Supports caring for seniors through accessible transit, community housing, and affordable property taxes
Supports hiring more people with disabilities and ensuring no neighbourhood is left behind
Supports strong public services and unionized public-sector workers
Supports culturally sensitive health services for racialized communities
